sourceAlgorithm: For each original residual generator G_i find scaled nonnegative packing numerator n_i with each future cell load sum_(G_i contains x) n_i <=D. If sum n_i > D*opponentTotalTurns and opponent independently source-certified unable to win, guaranteed owner first win by full-board contradiction; no future game value computed.
sourceSearchScope: Finite predeclared denominators 1,2,3,4,6,8,12 and six deterministic generator orders with 1/floor(D/2)/D quota patterns; static algebraic witness attempts not strategic continuations.

physicalSample.source: 1,000 deterministic seeded nonwinning-prefix physical trajectories, plus canonical prefixes, nonterminal first-win-stopped, LCG seed=698820097

qualification_limits: All 47 additional exact optimal sets are relative to a lightweight CPC/immediate-source baseline, not yet an incremental comparison against every previously known full one-lane/co-release source rule on 7x6.
Sample is nonuniform and mostly mid/endgame, not a completeness percentage for all 7x6 q.

All 135 emitted first-action certificates were independently checked against unrestricted 7x6 physical future WDL. The physical reference DOES recursively evaluate game continuations, only AFTER source producer returned; that work is excluded from source semantic fanout.

All observed successful weights were integral D=1 (disjoint surviving requirements). Fractional D>1 may be mathematically stronger but was not observed as a necessary successful witness in this sample.
